messages:
sara: heads-up: found several differences between REST -> SDK (js v0.8.1) during streaming generate calls. This is causing flaky behavior in our examples and a bug in retries.
leo: can you summarize the deltas?
sara: short list: 1) param names: REST uses `temperature`, `max_new_tokens`, `top_p`. SDK exposes `temp`, `maxTokens`, `nucleus`. 2) SDK's streaming flag is ignored in one code path so `stream: true` sometimes does full-response. 3) auth refresh mid-stream closes SDK stream without automatic reconnect; REST + client lib auto-retries.
anya: wow, that's a lot. sample apps might be silently broken. Which sample?
sara: `examples/streaming-demo` README uses REST names; some users copy-paste into SDK sample and it breaks.
mike: repro for auth: create long-running generate (~1000 tokens) with short-lived token. On REST we see server send a 401 chunk, client refreshes token and resumes. On SDK we see stream closed and Error thrown.
leo: do we have request id / idempotency to resume?
sara: yes, `request_id` exists but SDK isn't attaching it to the reconnect flow. Server will accept replay if same request_id is provided.
anya: any difference in error codes in the SDK?
sara: SDK surfaces: `Error: stream terminated (401)` and no retry. Headers show `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_token\"`.
mike: param drift is annoying because telemetry uses canonical names. If SDK calls map to different param names we lose signal in dashboards.
leo: solution proposal: 1) add a compatibility shim to SDK that maps REST names -> SDK internal names (temperature -> temp, max_new_tokens -> maxTokens, top_p -> nucleus). 2) wire request_id into streaming reconnect and implement retry-on-auth-refresh with replay. 3) add opt-out flag `streamingRetry: false` for customers who want fail-fast.
anya: +1. Also update the quickstart examples to use the canonical SDK-friendly names or show both variants.
sara: I'll open a PR with a small test that force-expires the token mid-stream. That will be in `examples/ci/test_streaming_auth_reconnect.sh`.
leo: devex-bot: created issue #512 for "SDK parity: streaming retry + parameter mapping + example updates"
devex-bot: Issue #512 created by leo: "SDK parity fixes: param aliasing (temperature,max_new_tokens,top_p), streaming auth-reconnect using request_id, config flag streamingRetry"
mike: logging note: when we add shim, also emit a single deprecation warning at runtime when a mapped alias is used so customers know to migrate.
sara: agreed. Also update CHANGELOG and bump patch to 0.8.2. This should be a patch release.
anya: do we want to run a quick internal beta against a handful of teams who rely on streaming?
leo: yes, let's roll to canary and monitor errors in the Console for the next 48h. I'll add a telemetry event `sdk_param_alias_used` and `sdk_stream_reconnect_attempted` so we can measure hit rates.
sara: tagging @mike for dashboards update and @anya for examples. Will link PR in issue.
mike: noted. I'll add a Grafana panel to show streaming reconnect failures by sdk_version.
leo: ETA: PR by EOD today, tests and canary tomorrow, patch release after 48h canary.
sara: thanks team. if anyone finds other naming drift (esp. in embeddings/ reranking) drop them here and i'll add to the issue. :sparkles:
